# Ouranós, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does
The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Ouranós** works now.

Ouranós is the first tyrant of Greek cosmogony: a father who fears his children and is destroyed by one of them. His fall sets the pattern of divine succession.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ouranós
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Sky
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Technology & Innovation · Commerce & Governance · Energy & Natural World
- **Strongest seat:** Space, Astronomy & Celestial Science
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 185 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Birth and Union with Gē.** After Chaos and Gē came Ouranós, 'starry' and equal to her in size.  He covered Gē on every side and became the secure seat of the blessed gods. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**The Castration.** Ouranós hated his children and forced them back into Gē's womb.  In pain, Gē fashioned a great sickle of adamant and persuaded Kronos to lie in wait. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Space, Astronomy & Celestial Science

*Space agencies, astronomy, and the orbital economy. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Heaven personified — and the planet Uranus keeps his name.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Aviation & Aerospace

*Flight, aerospace engineering, and the sky economy. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*Heaven personified; the destination above the weather.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Ancestry & Heritage Services

*Genealogy, heritage research, and DNA ancestry. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Father of Titans, Cyclopes, and Hundred-Handers; every Olympian pedigree opens with his line.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Meteorology & Weather Intelligence

*Forecasting, storm tracking, and climate analytics. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The sky is the forecaster's subject; modern Greek still calls the weather's theater ouranós.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ouranós performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Ouranós is the first tyrant of Greek cosmogony: a father who fears his children and is destroyed by one of them. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in space, astronomy & celestial science, aviation & aerospace, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/ouranos/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
